name: @pipeworx/mcp-microsoft-todo

tools.name: list_task_lists
tools.description: List the Microsoft To Do task lists for the signed-in user, with display names and whether each is a well-known list (e.g. the default "Tasks" or flagged-email list). Use to discover a to-do list and its ID before listing tasks or reminders.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks in a Microsoft To Do list. Returns compact task summaries (title, status, importance, due date, created/completed times, and a body preview). Optionally filter by status. Use to browse a user's to-do list and see what tasks or reminders it contains.

list_id.description: The ID of the Microsoft To Do task list to read (from list_task_lists).

top.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default 50, max 100).

status.description: Optional filter restricting results to tasks with this status.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get the full details of a single Microsoft To Do task by its list ID and task ID, including title, status, importance, full body/notes, due date, reminder time, created/completed times, and any checklist (sub-task) items. Use after list_tasks or find_due_tasks to read a to-do item in full.

list_id.description: The ID of the Microsoft To Do task list containing the task.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to retrieve (from a list or find result).

tools.name: find_due_tasks
tools.description: Find upcoming, incomplete Microsoft To Do tasks across all of the user's to-do lists that are due within the next N days. Returns a flat list of due reminders with their list name, title, due date, and importance. Use to answer "what tasks are due soon" or "what are my upcoming reminders".

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to look for due tasks (default 7).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-microsoft-todo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the microsoft-todo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
